messages:
incident-bot: ⚠️ ALERT — Elevated error rate observed on /v1/stream (us-west-2). 502/504 spike + client disconnects. Triggered by anomaly detector at 2026-03-15T10:04:49Z. Auto-mitigation: none applied yet. Playbook: https://redwood.support/incident-playbooks/streaming

mike_oncall: ack, I'm on it. grabbing logs and metric links. tagging eli + robin.

eli_engineer: looking — I see repeated upstream timeouts from streaming-proxy -> model-backend. sample log: ```[2026-03-15T10:05:12Z] WARN stream-handler: upstream timeout after 30s, client_id=abc123, req=/v1/stream
[2026-03-15T10:05:12Z] ERROR http: upstream prematurely closed connection, chunked write failure```

robin_sre: same. Gateway (nginx) shows 502 from upstream keepalive resets. connection_reuse failures ramping up. Likely long-tail requests + too-small upstream buffers.

kira_support: multiple customers on mobile reported aborted streams and partial generations ~10:05-10:08. Escalating to SEs for impacted accounts, adding to incident status page. Customers with id prefix cust-az* most affected.

mike_oncall: immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) enable paged fallback for new requests (X-Prefer-Paged header) 2) increase gateway upstream_timeout to 45s 3) scale streaming-proxy pods +3. I'll apply 2+3, eli please prepare routing change for 1.

eli_engineer: prepping a quick routing override to send new traffic to dedicated-stream-2 pool and set header for clients that support paged. CLI to apply: ```redwoodctl routing update --pool dedicated-stream-2 --match "/v1/stream" --set-header "X-Prefer-Paged:1" --region us-west-2``` Will canary to 10% first.

ashley_infra: applied gateway config change in us-west-2: upstream_read_timeout=45s; increased worker_rlimit_nofile. Scaling streaming-proxy deployment +3 pods (replicas 6 -> 9). Pod restarts started at 10:07:03Z.

eli_engineer: canary routing applied to 10% at 10:07:45Z. Observing lower 5xx rate on canary path. Logs show paged requests succeed where streaming was failing (no chunked encoding).

robin_sre: pushed a temporary change to drop overly long client keep-alives at ingress to reduce stuck connections. Also enabled proxy-level heartbeat: `X-Stream-Heartbeat: true`.

kira_support: noted significant drop in newly reported customer aborts for canary cohort. Still seeing some postbacks from older clients that don't support paged fallback. Reaching out to top-affected accounts to advise toggling to paged.

incident-bot: Automated alert updates: 5xx rate in us-west-2 decreased from 8.2% -> 2.1% over 5m after mitigations. Monitoring for 20m.

mike_oncall: good progress. plan: keep mitigations for 30m, gradually ramp canary to 100% if metrics hold. eli + robin: capture logs and client traces for postmortem. Create follow-up action items: - permanent upstream tuning - ensure streaming-proxy auto-restart threshold - add graceful backoff for paged fallback. I'll open INC-2026-345 and assign.

eli_engineer: capturing traces now (`/ops/traces?since=10:00`). saved core dump from one streaming-proxy pod that had repeated chunked-write errors.

ashley_infra: alerting autoscaling team to review pod sizing; added an emergency autoscale policy to allow +50% burst for 30m.

robin_sre: also adding a temporary WAF rule to limit abusive long-poll clients that were amplifying connections.

mike_oncall: handoff plan — keep channel open for next 30m for observation, then transition to postmortem lane. Impact summary: customer-visible aborted streams (partial output) for ~35 mins, affected subset of mobile SDKs and some high-latency regions in us-west-2. Severity: P1 (customer-impacting).

kira_support: notifying customers with mitigation steps and ETA for full recovery.

mike_oncall: assigning postmortem to eli_engineer + robin_sre. I'll close the live incident once canary at 100% and 5xx <1% for 20m. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
